description: One coin by its mint address, as search_coins lists it: mint, symbol, name, image, venue (pump, meteora or bags), origin (launched on Souvenir or brought), mode (full: its rounds draw an item; draws: they pay drawSol in SOL; prizes: its creator awards prizes; redeem: no draws; holders burn coins for its one prize), potSol (the open pot), prize (full and redeem modes: id, image, priceUsd), round (the latest unfinished one: number, state, targetSol, potSol), holders (at the latest snapshot), links and pair ({ symbol, mint, solPerSouv } on a coin that trades against $SOUVENIR, else null). A coin that is not on Souvenir is not found.
name: get_coin
title: Get a Souvenir coin
